# CC Lane 001 — Validate CODE_MAP.md accuracy (FIRST after Lane 000)

**Goal:** The map was auto-generated. Before we bet the workflow on it, spot-check accuracy. Fix any drift found. Output a validation report so we know what to trust.

**Severity:** Validation. Read-heavy. Small writes only (fixes to map entries that are wrong, plus a one-page report).

**Branch:** `claude/validate-code-map`

This prompt assumes Lane 000 (CC_OVERNIGHT_LANE_000-generate-code-map) landed first. Verify before proceeding:

```bash
test -f app/CODE_MAP.md && echo OK || (echo "ABORT: CODE_MAP.md missing"; exit 1)
test -f docs/CODE_MAP_DESIGN.md && echo OK || (echo "ABORT: design doc missing"; exit 1)
grep -q "Read the map first" CLAUDE.md || (echo "ABORT: CLAUDE.md policies missing"; exit 1)
```

## §0 Setup

```bash
cd <repo root>
git checkout main && git pull origin main
git checkout -b claude/validate-code-map
```

## §1 What to validate

Pick **10 random entries** across the map's three big indexes:
- 4 functions from the Function Index (mix of inline + extracted)
- 3 modules from the Module Index
- 3 tabs from the Tab Index

For RANDOM, use a deterministic-but-spread sample (e.g., lines `100, 300, 700, 1200, 1800, 2400, 2900, 3200, 3500, 3800` of `app/CODE_MAP.md`, taking the function/module/tab row at each).

## §2 For each function entry, verify:

```bash
# Function row says: "| funcName | inline @ L#### | window+inline | tabname |"
# OR "| funcName | modules/area/file.js | window+CL | tabname |"

# Verification:
# If "inline @ L####":
grep -nE "^(async )?function +funcName\b" app/index.html
# Confirm: the line returned matches L####  ±5 lines (small drift OK)

# If "modules/area/file.js":
grep -nE "function +funcName\b" app/modules/area/file.js
# Confirm: function is in the named module
```

Record for each:
- Map says: `<location>`
- Actually at: `<location>`
- Match: ✅ EXACT | ⚠️ DRIFT (±N lines) | ❌ WRONG

## §3 For each module entry, verify:

```bash
# Module row says: "| modules/area/file.js | ~NN LOC | area | apiCount fns | tabs |"
wc -l app/modules/area/file.js
# Confirm LOC count matches ±20%
grep -c "^window\." app/modules/area/file.js
# Confirm public API function count matches apiCount
```

Record for each:
- Map says: `<api-count>` fns, `~<loc>` LOC
- Actually: `<api-count>` fns, `<loc>` LOC
- Match: ✅ | ⚠️ | ❌

## §4 For each tab entry, verify:

```bash
# Tab section says:
#  - Content div: #tab-<id>  → confirm DOM element exists
#  - HTML template: inline L<start>-L<end> → confirm those lines contain the tab div
#  - Modules: [list] → confirm each module file exists
#  - Inline functions: [list] → confirm each function exists at its claimed location

grep -n 'id="tab-<id>"' app/index.html
sed -n '<start>,<end>p' app/index.html | head -3  # confirm tab div is at this range
for m in <listed modules>; do test -f app/modules/$m && echo OK $m || echo MISSING $m; done
```

Record for each:
- Content div: ✅ | ❌
- HTML range: ✅ | ⚠️ drift | ❌
- Modules: <N>/<N> exist
- Inline functions verified: <N>/<N> at claimed location

## §5 Fix drift inline

If any entry has DRIFT (±20 lines or wrong but recoverable):
- Edit `app/CODE_MAP.md` to correct the location
- Note the fix in the validation report

If any entry is WRONG (function doesn't exist at all, module file missing, wrong tab):
- Mark as ❌ in the report
- DO NOT delete the entry — leave it so Murad can investigate
- Add a "⚠️ NEEDS INVESTIGATION" prefix to the row

```markdown

## Summary

- Exact matches: <N>/10
- Drift fixed: <N>/10
- Investigation needed: <N>/10

[list of `app/CODE_MAP.md` edits]

```

## §7 Commit & push

```bash
git add app/CODE_MAP.md docs/CODE_MAP_VALIDATION_2026-05-21.md
git commit -m "validate(code-map): spot-check 10 random entries, fix drift, write report

- Function index: <N>/<N> exact, <N> drift fixed, <N> need investigation
- Module index: <N>/<N> exact
- Tab index: <N>/<N> exact
- Verdict: <GREEN|YELLOW|RED>

See docs/CODE_MAP_VALIDATION_2026-05-21.md for full report.

The validation confirms (or flags) the map's accuracy so we can trust the
CLAUDE.md Policy 1 (read-map-first) workflow."
git push -u origin claude/validate-code-map
```

## §8 Out of scope

- Don't extract any new modules (extract-on-touch flow starts on REAL work tasks, not this validation)
- Don't regenerate the whole map (separate prompt if needed)
- Don't modify `CLAUDE.md` (policies are already set)
- Don't modify `app/index.html`
- No PR

```

- Exact matches: <N>
- Drift fixed: <N>
```

**If verdict is GREEN:** Murad can confidently start using the map-first + extract-on-touch workflow.
**If YELLOW:** Map is mostly usable; investigate the flagged entries before relying on those sections.
**If RED:** Re-generate the map (run Lane 000 again, or use the auto-regen script when available).
